coverage.scope: Original license files and source notices for 38 registry crate versions plus the resvg/usvg and woff2 fixed Git sources identified in the distributed WASM. Additional license files within a confirmed crate are retained as package notices without claiming every such file is linked.
limitations: Embedded source paths are a lower bound; optimized code may have no retained source path.
The resvg-js release source has no Cargo.lock or upstream aggregate THIRD-PARTY/NOTICE. The renderer fork has its own lockfile, which is not the npm WASM build lockfile.
The committed wasm/index_bg.wasm in the source tag differs from the npm-distributed WASM. This ledger binds the npm artifact moduleSha256 above, confirmed directly against the official npm tarball.
No fonts from dependency tests or example applications are asserted to be embedded; their test-only license files are excluded.

dependencies.name: pathfinder_content
dependencies.note: Official crate omits standalone license files. Exact original source headers permit Apache-2.0 or MIT; this distribution selects Apache-2.0 and includes its official text. Historical vcs commit f9dab5a3fd6c0cf4fd4f0f3f17843a68c9fed835 was unavailable from the declared upstream during this audit; no historical root license was substituted.
